# s1_2_decide

**In one sentence:** A leftover alias package that only re-exports the CLI review helpers from `../review.py`.

## What's inside
| File / folder | What it does |
|---|---|
| `__init__.py` | Re-exports `_manual_review` and `_review_gallery_or_fallback` from `quality_gate/review.py`. No code of its own. |

## Who uses it
- Nothing imports this package. `prepare_lora_kit/interaction.py` (`CliInteractionProvider.source_review`) imports `quality_gate.review` directly.
- The name survives only as a string in `prepare_lora_kit/utils/state.py` (`_SUBSTEP_MIGRATIONS`: `s1_2_decide` -> `review_decisions`), used to upgrade old run-state files.
